items.stem: Why turn on multi-factor sign-in for email first?
choices: Password resets for other accounts arrive there

items.stem: What must never appear in the safety plan?
choices: The name of the password manager
An actual password or recovery code

items.stem: Why name a person or desk for strange messages?
choices: So nobody judges a convincing scam alone

items.stem: What should the backup section record besides locations?
choices: The date of the last test restore

items.stem: During review, what does a mentor ask the learner to do?
choices: Show one step live, such as opening a backed-up file
In a text message to a friend
In the password manager or locked away on paper
